To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the addition of prebiotics to broilers’ diet did not affect the cecal bacterial community structure, but it did increase the abundance of some beneficial bacteria, including the Lactobacillus genus, while reducing the abundance of the harmful bacteria Clostridium and Escherichia.

1) prebiotics have a positive effect on the cecal microbiota in broilers, 2) the cecal microbiome is affected by the prebiotic dose, 3) cecal microbial composition is affected by the time point of the experiment, 4) prebiotics can be considered as a tool to manipulate the cecal microbiomes in broilers, and 5) the cecal bacterial composition is affected by age
prebiotics can be used as an alternative feed additive to antibiotics in the broiler industry.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the cecal microbiota of broilers fed a diet containing prebiotics and the possible effect of this prebiotic on the cecal microbiome of broilers.
the effect of prebiotic supplementation of broiler feed on cecal microbiota.
the cecal microbiota in broilers fed with prebiotics, and the aim is to determine the influence of the diet on the composition of the microbiota and its relationship with the production parameters.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the cecal microbiota in broilers fed prebiotic diets are not as diverse as in the control diet.
the cecal microbiota in broiler chickens can be modulated by prebiotics.
the use of prebiotics in poultry diets is an important and useful strategy to improve gut health and performance of birds (Huygbeaert et al.,2011).
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have demonstrated that prebiotics are effective at improving broiler cecal microbiota, and this improvement is likely associated with the reduction of cecal pH and the reduction of pathogenic bacteria such as Clostridium perfringens and Salmonella spp
prebiotics can be used as feed additives in the poultry industry to modulate the cecal microbiota and to improve the health and productivity of broilers.
we found that the cecal microbiota was significantly different in birds fed prebiotics, and that the cecal bacterial community structure was significantly different between prebiotics.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the cecal microbiome of broilers fed prebiotics was more similar to that of the unchallenged control than the cecal microbiomes of birds fed antibiotics or challenged with E. coli or C. perfringens.
prebiotic supplementation of broiler feed can alter the cecal microbiota, which in turn can influence host health and performance.
cecal microbiota in broilers is affected by prebiotic supplementation, and that the effects are not limited to the cecal lumen.
